reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount helper and the server config, provider list and sync dispatch are extended in place; downloading has no shared helper in the tree and is written as a new per-provider function.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping) instead of extracting a shared download for the identical provider API.

placement.why: Each piece lands where its siblings live: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, account type in types/models.

scope.why: Mostly server-side as asked; the two desktop-client edits are the minimum the widened provider union forces, with Fintegra hard-wired as not configured.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow and consistent with existing providers, but adds another copied download function and another provider check to the starting-balance branch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses linkBankSyncAccount for linking; no existing download abstraction exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/sync.ts is an open copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised.
